pre_mortem: It's Monday and Henry under 46.5 lost the ticket because the backup could not stay on schedule, Chicago led, and Henry was at 12 carries for the low 30s while Hill took third down — the same shape as his 33- and 42-yard recent games, with the 122 exposed as a spike. Andrews lost beside it if that game was also run-only the other way, or he lost alone on a 22-yard, low-YPT afternoon while Flowers and Hill took the easy yards against backup corners. The stronger process miss is betting median stand-ins with no no-vig: if the real close had already lifted Henry into the mid-50s and Andrews into the mid-30s, this read had no price edge. Weather was never saved, so a surprise wind or rain was not in the card.
slip_story: One story only: Lamar-out, close home lean, Henry carries the clock and Andrews catches the must-have middle throws. Do not add Flowers or Odunze overs, a total over, or any Swift/Monangai leg until inactives. Not a TD slip. One market per player. Both legs die together only if Baltimore is forced into a pass-heavy chase that still misses Andrews; a blowout the other way (Henry 25 carries, 15 passes) splits them.
